messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Re: funny trace
parts:
Hi,

Maybe this is more generic than you're looking for but this just looks like a typical transition from initial values to (?) convergence in a complex model.  My guess is coeffs[2,4,5] have a relatively flat posterior for large values of a which I would visualize by plotting a on the x acis, coeffs[2,4,5] on the y axis, and density/log density on the z axis. If you don't want to bother making the whole surface sometimes just plotting the trace in that space color-coded for density will show the effect. 

Krzysztof

That's pretty neat. I think you're seeing an adjustment to the warmup parameters right before sampling.

Questions:
How are you initializing?
Have you run more chains and do they all do the same?
What happens if you warmup for less iterations?
What interface, compiler, OS are you using? Have you tried a different one just on case it's a bug?

Daniel
